verdict: AI spending supercycle accelerating (Goldman raises 2027 capex to $1.2T); Fed rate hike Sep 24 crushed solar (FSLR -10.3%). AMD Helios shipping, MRVL-Google deal reshaping custom compute.
body_md:
## Fresh Developments (Last 24-72h)

**1. Goldman Sachs raises 2027 hyperscaler capex to $1.2T (Sep 25)** — GS strategists project five largest US hyperscalers will spend ~$1.2T in AI capex in 2027, +50% YoY and above the Wall Street consensus of ~$1.1T. Separate Sep 26 note frames a $7.6T AI spending boom through 2030 and pivots toward power/grid/cooling plays over pure GPU exposure.

**2. Fed rate hike Sep 24 crushes solar** — First Fed rate increase in three years triggered sector-wide utility solar selloff: **FSLR -10.3% to ~$172** (52-week low); **ENPH -4.5% to ~$32**. Project financing costs spiked. FSLR guidance intact; GF Value implies ~$252 fair value.

**3. AMD +2.4% Sep 25; Helios shipping now** — BofA raised AMD PT $620→$720, maintaining Buy. AMD Helios rack (72x MI455X, 2.9 exaFLOPS, HBM4, ~$5.25M/rack) delivering first units to Microsoft Azure and Oracle in late Q3 — the ramp is live.

**4. MRVL-Google landmark; AVGO under pressure** — Google issued Marvell a warrant for ~$12.18B equity stake tied to custom chip revenue milestones; MRVL Investor Day Oct 6 is a near-term catalyst. AVGO has fallen 10%+ from recent highs as markets price in Google dual-sourcing.

**5. HIVE $350M Blackwell GPU cloud contract** — BUZZ HPC signed a 5-year deal with an investment-grade enterprise customer (~$70M/year ARR), deploying 2,016 NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra GPUs in Q4 2026. Total pipeline >$1B. FY2026 revenue $297.8M (+158% YoY). Confirms the BTC-miner-to-AI pivot is generating real contracted revenue.

**6. CRDO $750M DustPhotonics acquisition (Sep 20)** — Credo buying Silicon Photonics/PIC capabilities in-house; Mizuho cut PT $290→$245. Stock off 43% from 52-wk high despite 115% revenue growth. ZeroFlap optical transceiver launched Sep 15.

**7. COHR PhotonLink CPO platform launched (Sep 21)** — Coherent unveiled integrated optics platform for CPO/NPO/chip-to-chip connectivity at ECOC 2026; demoed 6.4T NPO optical engine. Revenue ramp expected Q4 CY2026.

**8. DRAM 4Q26 outlook revised up (TrendForce Sep 16)** — Q3 QoQ contract gains decelerated to +13-18% (vs. +90-95% Q1), but TrendForce Sep 16 bulletin raised the 4Q26 forward outlook on continued CSP/AI demand. No correction signal; HBM sold out into 2027. Correction consensus pushed to 2028+. **MU FY2026 Q4 earnings due Sep 30** — next big primary data point.

**9. Section 232 solar tariffs** — 15% ad valorem on polysilicon and derivative solar products effective Dec 4, 2026 (signed Aug 6). FSLR longer-term beneficiary as domestic manufacturer; Chinese module imports hit hardest.

**10. NOK +4%** — Microsoft partnership expansion + Rosenblatt Buy initiation; AI-RAN narrative gaining traction.

## Context vs Baseline

- **Capex not slowing**: Baseline assumed no guide-down; confirmed. Goldman now raises 2027 to $1.2T.
- **HBM correction pushed out**: SK Hynix's "correction after 2026" warning has been superseded — analyst consensus now 2028+ only. HBM4 ramp intact.
- **Optical supply crunch deepening**: InP now at "allocation" status; 800G lead times >40 weeks. Matches baseline warning of demand ~2x supply.
- **Solar rate risk materialized**: Fed hike Sep 24 is the clearest macro risk to the solar complex this week.

---

---

## Most Important Development

Goldman Sachs (Sep 25) raising 2027 hyperscaler AI capex to **$1.2T** — above consensus — is the single most important data point of the last 72 hours. It reaffirms the AI infrastructure supercycle is accelerating into 2027, not decelerating. On the same day, the Fed's first rate hike in three years sent FSLR to 52-week lows (-10.3%). AI/semi complex bull thesis intact; solar facing near-term rate headwinds. Watch MU Sep 30 earnings for the next primary memory pricing read.
